budget_origin: Pre-run initial exposure v2: 262144 joint steps rounded up to whole rollout; not convergence or success criterion
selection_basis: All native actions categorical. Per-role native returns; no assumed shared team reward. Parameter sharing with explicit role index permits different role policies and bounds memory at up to 768 roles. Local observations only, no privileged critic.
memory_limit: Four local frames, feedforward; partial observation can require recurrent follow-up, not claimed sufficient.

task.objective: Route physical parcels to each owner private depot requirement. Delivery pays its beneficiary +1 and actual delivering courier +1/4. Actual bridge payments cost payer amount/16 reward; non-wait actions cost actor 1/128.
task.natural_termination: All three fixed parcel identities have been delivered to their correct depots, or truncate at 96 otherwise. At terminal, outstanding unused-slot deposits are cancelled and refunded.
task.interaction: Simultaneous bounded bids reserve one physical bridge entry slot, highest bid wins with rotating deterministic tie order, winner pays and losers recover deposits. Parcel swaps and consent-based transfers can save crossings. Posting an order changes other carriers available information.
task.observation_access: Private need[i] is observed only by agent i and is never a scene attribute. Posted orders, credits, escrow, payments, permit and delivery registration are public. Agent/active parcel payloads are visible within L1 radius 3. Delivery legal masks depend on any depot, never on hidden target correctness.

native_event_definitions.meaning: Actual bridge payment by each courier this step
Settlement phase processed, including rounds with no bids
Public registration of each newly delivered parcel

primary_metric: mean across roles of unmodified native episode returns; inspect role vector and task events, mean can cancel in competitive games
evaluation_policy: stochastic legal-action sampling; same independent seeds and native horizon for random/IPPO
selection_rule: No selection by evaluation; initial final checkpoint reported, every intermediate point retained
stop_rule: Complete frozen joint-step exposure. Stop safely for nonfinite values, native contract error, resource limit, or explicit coordinator/user instruction. Wall slices resume same identity.
scope: Existing Crucibles games only; does not implement original LLM/UED/meta-gradient experiment
